name: FileSeal
shortDescription: File encryption/decryption with AES-256-GCM and scrypt key derivation; safe, documented container format.
features: AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption (established library, never custom ciphers)
scrypt KDF with random per-file salt
Versioned container format with header bound as associated data
Wrong-key and tamper detection (deliberately indistinguishable errors)
Originals preserved; atomic writes leave no partial output
